{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1792986126120,"sessionID":"ses_e89b413f0ffeM1y69RSteJyUxQ","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"toolu_019DkFRdwMQ82sqprCFDUXJ1","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/nbody_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_cuda_r2/nbody/CMakeLists.txt","content":"cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.18)\nproject(nbody_benchmark LANGUAGES CXX CUDA)\n\nset(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)\nset(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)\nset(CMAKE_CUDA_STANDARD 20)\nset(CMAKE_CUDA_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)\n\n# GPU architectures to build device code for (sm_70 through sm_90)\nif(NOT DEFINED CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES)\n    set(CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES 70 75 80 86 89 90)\nendif()\n\nadd_executable(nbody nbody.cpp)\n\n# nbody.cpp is compiled as CUDA source (it contains the GPU kernels)\nset_source_files_properties(nbody.cpp PROPERTIES LANGUAGE CUDA)\n\n# Enable optimizations; host-compiler flags are forwarded through -Xcompiler\ntarget_compile_options(nbody PRIVATE\n    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CUDA>:-O3 -Xcompiler=-march=native,-Wall,-Wextra>\n)\n\n# Link math library\ntarget_link_libraries(nbody m)\n"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/nbody_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_cuda_r2/nbody/CMakeLists.txt","exists":true,"truncated":false},"title":"home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/nbody_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_cuda_r2/nbody/CMakeLists.txt","time":{"start":1792986126068,"end":1792986126080}},"metadata":{"anthropic":{"caller":{"type":"direct"}}},"id":"prt_1764d130d001kt1ks5X4eDTIm3","sessionID":"ses_e89b413f0ffeM1y69RSteJyUxQ","messageID":"msg_1764d08bc00102iacX5Mtf0FqO"}}
